content:
Context: 5. Monthly subscription and amount of Insurance Cover:-

If any of the nominated members of the family subsequently ceases to be the member of the family under any circumstances, nomination made for example, a minor brother on attaining majority or an unmarried sister on getting married. Their share of insurance amount in such cases, will be paid to other  
in favour of such member would become invalid nominated members of the family in equal shares.  
- Paras. 19.3, 19.4, 19.5 and 19.9.
